purpose: Prepare a complete isolated Hermes plus audio-io environment from exact existing candidate inputs at its intended final path.

audio_inputs.archive_verification: Exact whole ZIP digest and byte length, then every member size, SHA-256 and ZIP CRC; all member pins are embedded in the new preparer.

main_cffi_preserved.policy: Preserve the main wheel archive; compare all uncompressed members to the separately audited audio wheel.

audio_inputs.distribution_count_interpretation: 102 is the complete catalog union. Actual manager and application installed counts must be derived independently from their canonical frozen, marker-evaluated exports; no 102-installed-distribution claim is made.

opensles_wrapper.installation: Extract exact official member into the owned prepared payload; do not install the archive or borrow an unreviewed ambient wrapper.

audio_libraries.platform_requirement: The official wrapper still requires the real Android OpenSL ES framework and audio services. Physical capture additionally needs appropriate permission and a user-started device test.
audio_libraries.historical_container_result: PortAudio initialization error -9999 was observed in the historical audio lane. That failure is preserved and not reported as VAD success.
audio_libraries.inference_limit: Absent Docker framework/services explain the expected limitation, but this preparation receipt does not claim a newly traced native initialization call.

source_patch.application: All four real payload paths are included. The stdlib applier accepts exact original lines and exact hunk positions only, supports the pinned new-file zero-length hunk, verifies every output hash before writing, and allows no extra paths.

canonical_preparation.native_runtime: Exact bundled CPython 3.14.6 on Android AArch64 at the standard com.termux prefix.
canonical_preparation.manager: Import canonical PM from owned source using the original bundled Python; import verified_tools from pm.build_operations; stage_manager_runtime builds a fresh offline manager with the 102-wheel catalog.
canonical_preparation.application: Use canonical build_environment with all eight extras, frozen=True, offline=True, explicit=True, sealed=True and no_install_project=True.
canonical_preparation.graph_verification: Canonical frozen exports determine marker-evaluated manager/application selections. The catalog must supply every selected dependency; installed distribution names and versions and every wheel-owned installed file are checked.
canonical_preparation.install_scheme_policy: Only normal wheel paths plus .data/purelib and .data/platlib are accepted. Any other .data installation scheme fails for explicit review rather than silently skipping integrity checks.
canonical_preparation.installed_file_policy: Byte-compare each wheel-owned file except the installer-rewritten .dist-info/RECORD. Extra generated metadata is handled by canonical Hermes assembly.
canonical_preparation.source_binding: Canonical AgentInputs placement=contained, assemble, link sealing, PM-runtime sealing and Venv expected stamps bind the actual final path.
canonical_preparation.relocation: Payload is placed before environment creation. Finished environments are not moved; reconstruct from exact inputs at any new intended final path. No PYTHONHOME shim or metadata version relaxation.
canonical_preparation.ownership: Refuse an existing output; isolate profiles/caches/temp paths; rebuild only extracted copies of venv and pm-runtime; preserve all original Python/UV/runtime bytes, original inputs and installed payload.
canonical_preparation.repeatability: Workflow performs two fresh offline preparations in separate containers and paths, then compares canonical catalog/source/selected distribution-file results. It does not require path-dependent bytecode or venv metadata hashes to match.
canonical_preparation.evidence: Preparation and probe record full payload inventories, canonical selected counts, runtime maps and diagnostics; timeout failures preserve captured stdout and stderr.

earlier_checkpoint.interpretation: Historical checkpoint before the four-path source correction and added concrete file-integrity cases; do not add it to the final test count.

source_bootstrap.invocation: python -I -S -B using actual canonical source PM modules, no site-packages
source_bootstrap.stage_manager_runtime_result: Canonical missing-tool InstallError reached before creation on the host.
source_bootstrap.limit: This proves stdlib-only bootstrap imports and the guarded stage entry. Actual ARM tool verification and manager/application creation are reserved for native validation.

static_and_patch_gates.exact_four_path_patch_replay: passed against real baseline plus absent new-file path; all final bytes match the separately patched reference

cached_wheel_scheme_inspection.limit: This is the available cached main overlap subset, not all 100 main or all 102 union wheels; native canonical verification checks every selected wheel.

remaining_native_gates: Fresh canonical manager build with actual bundled ARM Python/UV
Fresh full application graph with audio-io
Actual library closure and separate PortAudio initialization outcome
Independent second preparation at a different final path
validation.physical_audio_test: Not performed, not claimed and not enabled by the probe.

deliverables.trigger: workflow_dispatch only; root reviews and dispatches
deliverables.reconstruction_contents: Exact candidate, verified audio inputs, original source patch, exact new preparation scripts, shared fetcher, device instructions, complete input file SHA map; uploaded before native validation.
deliverables.native_device_command: bash scripts/run_audio_hermes_preparation.sh --native candidate audio-inputs patches/next-stable/audio-readiness.patch "$HOME/hermes-audio-next-stable-20261017" prepare-and-probe
